c.v: In each unit, channel 0 and channel 1 can be configured to work independently or together.
The three subsections below provide details of channel 0 incrementing independently, channel 0 decrementing independently, and channel 0 and channel 1 incrementing together.

For other working modes not elaborated in this section (e.g., channel 1 incrementing/decremeting independently, or one channel incrementing while the other decrementing), reference can be made to these three subsections.
